soru: Although the vaccine proved highly effective in laboratory tests, ----.
secenekler: it was tested on thousands of volunteers
it failed to produce the same results in large-scale clinical trials
many doctors recommended it to their patients
scientists were pleased with its success
it was approved for use in many countries soon afterwards
aciklama: 'Although' zıtlık gerektirir: laboratuvarda etkili olan aşı, geniş çaplı denemelerde aynı sonucu verememiştir.

soru: If the ice sheets in Greenland and Antarctica melted completely, ----.
secenekler: the climate will have become cooler
sea levels would rise by several metres
aciklama: 'If + Simple Past' (Type 2) ana cümlede 'would + V1' ister.

soru: The Amazon rainforest, ----, is often described as the lungs of the planet.
secenekler: that it produces much of the oxygen
what produces a lot of oxygen
which produces a significant proportion of the world's oxygen
aciklama: Virgüllü (ek bilgi veren) sıfat cümleciği 'which' ile kurulur ve özne tekrar edilmez.

soru: ----, the number of people using public transport in the city has continued to decline.
secenekler: Even though ticket prices have been reduced considerably
Because the service has become faster and cheaper
Since traffic congestion has become worse
As more bus routes have been added
Now that fuel prices have risen sharply
aciklama: Kullanımın azalmaya devam etmesi beklenmedik bir sonuçtur; bu yüzden zıtlık bildiren 'Even though' ile başlayan seçenek uygundur. Diğerleri kullanımı artıracak nedenlerdir.

soru: By the time the firefighters arrived at the scene, ----.
secenekler: the fire has spread to the roof
the fire will have been put out
the building had already burnt to the ground
aciklama: 'By the time + Simple Past' ana cümlede Past Perfect gerektirir: itfaiye gelmeden önce bina yanıp kül olmuştu.

soru: Scientists have not yet been able to determine ----.
secenekler: how many moons does the planet have
if does the planet have water
whether the planet could support any form of life
aciklama: Dolaylı sorularda düz cümle düzeni kullanılır; 'henüz belirleyemediler' anlamına 'whether' (olup olmadığı) uyar.

soru: The flight was delayed for three hours ----.
secenekler: in order that the weather would improve
even if there had been no problems
because of the heavy fog at the airport
so that passengers could arrive on time
aciklama: Rötarın nedeni sis olabilir → 'because of + isim öbeği'. Diğer seçenekler anlamsız bir amaç ya da koşul kurar.

soru: Unless the government takes immediate action to reduce emissions, ----.
secenekler: global temperatures will continue to rise
the problem has already been solved
the climate had become more stable
aciklama: 'Unless + Simple Present' gerçek koşuldur; ana cümlede 'will' gelir.

soru: Children ---- tend to perform better at school than those who skip it.
secenekler: who eat a healthy breakfast every morning
aciklama: İnsanları niteleyen 'who' gerekir; 'skip it' zamiri kahvaltıya gönderme yapar.

soru: Since the smartphone was introduced, ----.
secenekler: the way people communicate has changed dramatically
the way people communicate will change
people had used landlines more often
aciklama: 'Since + geçmiş zaman' ana cümlede Present Perfect gerektirir.

soru: Although the museum is free to enter, ----.
secenekler: it attracts millions of visitors every year
it is very popular with tourists
visitors are encouraged to make a small donation
aciklama: 'Although' zıtlık gerektirir: giriş ücretsiz olsa da bağış yapılması teşvik edilir.

soru: Many parents wonder ----.
secenekler: whether their children spend too much time in front of screens
how much time do children spend online
that their children spend too much time online
what do their children do online
if do their children use the internet safely
aciklama: 'wonder' fiilinden sonra dolaylı soru gelir ve düz cümle düzeni kullanılır.

soru: In order to improve their vocabulary, students should get used to ----.
aciklama: 'get used to' yapısındaki 'to' edattır; ardından fiil -ing alır.

soru: So popular did the exhibition become ----.
secenekler: because the tickets were very cheap
that the museum decided to extend it for another three months
so that more visitors could see it
aciklama: 'So + sıfat + did + özne + V1' devrik yapısı 'that' ile tamamlanır (o kadar … ki).

soru: Had the scientists not detected the error in time, ----.
secenekler: the satellite would have crashed into the ocean
the satellite crashed into the ocean
the satellite will crash into the ocean
the satellite has crashed into the ocean
aciklama: 'Had ... not detected' devrik Type 3 koşuldur → 'would have + V3'.

soru: The region, ----, attracts thousands of birdwatchers every spring.
secenekler: that is home to many birds
where more than two hundred species of birds stop during their migration
aciklama: Virgüllü (ek bilgi) cümlecikte 'that' kullanılmaz; yer bildiren 'where' + tam cümle doğrudur.

soru: Before a new medicine is sold to the public, ----.
secenekler: it must be tested extensively for safety and effectiveness
it was banned in many countries
patients are testing it at home
it has been tested on a few patients
aciklama: Genel kural anlatılıyor: ilaç satılmadan önce test edilmelidir (edilgen zorunluluk).

soru: The more people use public transport instead of private cars, ----.
secenekler: there will be more traffic congestion
the less traffic congestion there will be in cities
aciklama: 'The more ..., the less ...' yapısı; anlam olarak toplu taşıma arttıkça trafik azalır.

soru: When I arrived at the station, ----.
aciklama: Varıştan önce tamamlanmış eylem → Past Perfect.

soru: I have lived in this city ----.
aciklama: Present Perfect ile başlangıç noktası 'since' ile verilir.

soru: While she was reading a book, ----.
aciklama: Süren eylemi kesen kısa eylem → Simple Past.

soru: ----, he will call you.
secenekler: As soon as he had got home
As soon as he will get home
As soon as he gets home
As soon as he got home
As soon as he has been getting home
aciklama: Zaman cümleciğinde gelecek için Simple Present kullanılır.

soru: By the time the police arrived, ----.
aciklama: 'By the time + Simple Past' → ana cümlede Past Perfect.

soru: Scientists have been studying the disease ----.
aciklama: Süregelen eylemin süresi 'for' ile verilir.

soru: ----, the number of people using smartphones has increased dramatically.
secenekler: At the end of the last century
aciklama: Present Perfect ile günümüze uzanan dönem → 'Over the past decade'.

soru: By the time she finishes her degree next year, ----.
secenekler: she will have studied at three different universities
she has studied at three universities
she is studying at three universities
she had studied at three universities

alt_konu: It was the first time + Past Perfect
soru: It was the first time that ----.
secenekler: the team has won the championship
the team will win the championship
the team had won the championship
the team is winning the championship

soru: You look very tired; ----.
aciklama: Yorgun görünen birine tavsiye → 'should'.

soru: If you want to pass the exam, ----.

it must have rained during the night

soru: ----, but now I can't remember much of it.

I could speak French when I was a child

soru: He failed the exam; ----.

soru: ----, as the museum is free on Sundays.
secenekler: You had to buy a ticket
You don't need to buy a ticket
aciklama: Müze ücretsiz olduğu için bilet gerekmez.

soru: Although the bridge looks old, ----.
secenekler: it may be stronger than it seems
aciklama: 'Although' zıtlık ister: eski görünse de sağlam olabilir.

soru: The documents are missing from the safe; ----.
aciklama: Kayıp belgeler birinin aldığına dair güçlü çıkarım → 'must have taken'.

soru: ----, the ancient city might have survived much longer.
secenekler: Had it not been for the earthquake
aciklama: 'might have survived' gerçekleşmemiş geçmiş koşul ister → 'Had it not been for'.

soru: The new hospital ----.
secenekler: will open by the mayor next month
aciklama: Hastane açılan şeydir → edilgen 'will be opened'.

soru: ----, so I had to walk to school.

secenekler: which was painted in the 16th century

soru: After the fire, ----.
aciklama: Bina yeniden inşa edilen şeydir → 'was rebuilt'.

soru: Before the results can be published, ----.
secenekler: they have been checked last year
they must be checked by independent experts

thousands of people fined for littering

secenekler: which had been hidden for over 3,000 years
which had hidden for over 3,000 years

secenekler: I would have driven to work

soru: If it rains this afternoon, ----.
secenekler: we would have cancelled the picnic

soru: ----, I would buy a big house by the sea.
secenekler: If I had won the lottery
If I would win the lottery
If I will win the lottery

soru: If the doctors had diagnosed the illness earlier, ----.
aciklama: 'If + Past Perfect' → 'would have + V3'.

secenekler: Provided that you show your ID card
As long as you show your ID card
If you show your ID card
Unless you show your ID card
When you show your ID card

I have studied harder for last week's exam

secenekler: we would be at the airport now
we had been at the airport now
we are at the airport now
we have been at the airport now
we will be at the airport now

secenekler: you would contact the coordinator yesterday
you would have contacted the coordinator

secenekler: who takes care of people's teeth

which we had our first dinner

whose brother works with my father

soru: The book, ----, has been translated into forty languages.
aciklama: Virgüllü cümlecikte 'that' kullanılmaz → 'which'.

soru: Marie visited the town ----.
secenekler: which her grandparents had grown up
where her grandparents had grown up
who her grandparents had grown up

most of whom work in the main office
most of them work in the main office
most of which work in the main office
that most work in the main office

soru: The new law, ----, will come into force next month.

whose it aims to reduce pollution
its aim is to reduce pollution
that its aim is to reduce pollution

what time the museum does open

How were the pyramids built by the Egyptians

How the ancient Egyptians built the pyramids

soru: Nobody could explain ----.

the bacteria survived in extreme heat
aciklama: 'What ... was that + cümle' kalıbı (vurgu yapısı).

soru: Although it was very late, ----.

we went to the park instead

secenekler: As a result of the crisis

to build a new coal power station
build a new coal power station
